reason: The sepal apex is acuminate. Recording 'acuminate' on the sepal itself matches how apex shapes are usually annotated.
The bracts are 3-5 mm long. Bearer, quality and range all match.
The petals are attached to the sepal tube (the fused sepals). Attached to sepal is right.
The inflorescences are axillary, and FLOPO:0991000 lists inflorescence as a bearer.
The umbel has 7-9 bracts (the involucre). The count is right.
'base pubescent' follows 'leaf blades', so the bearer is the leaf lamina base. Right.

fix: In dimorphic ferns, 'sterile fronds X, fertile fronds Y' must keep the sterile/fertile state. Without it the record says every lamina is broad.
reason: The lamina is dimorphic. Only the sterile fronds are broad; the fertile fronds are 'narrowed'. Without the 'sterile' qualifier the annotation contradicts the fertile fronds.

fix: 'long-lived annual' is an annual. 'long-lived' is a degree modifier, not a separate life-span value; don't map it to increased life span instead of the life-span class.
reason: The alternatives are perennial or annual (long-lived). Increased life span stands in for 'annual' and loses it.
The branchlets (a synonym of branch) are appressed-pilose when young, and the young state is recorded. 'appressed' is not captured, but nothing recorded is false.
The stipules are 2–3 mm long.
The bracts are blackish, recorded as approximately black.

fix: 'lowest bract ... longer than X; upper bracts ...' must keep the position qualifier (lowest/upper) on the bearer.
reason: Only the lowest bract is longer than the inflorescence. The upper bracts are 5-7 mm, far shorter than the 10-15 cm inflorescence.

fix: Ideally keep the 'upper' position for glumes, but here no statement becomes false.
reason: The upper glume surface is glabrous or pilose. Recording these as alternatives on the glume is acceptable; the 'upper' position is lost, but that doesn't make the record false.
The calyx is 5-lobed with the 4 upper lobes joined, so the sepals are fused. Partial fusion ('4 upper') is not captured, but fused is true.

fix: 'Filaments' should map to filament (PO_0009067), not be generalised to stamen. The anthers are measured separately (3-5 mm).
reason: The 1 cm length is the filament's, not the whole stamen's.
The glumes are 0.8–1.7 mm long.
The corolla is strongly exserted (beyond the calyx) at anthesis. The stage is recorded.

fix: 'bractlet(s)' and 'involucel' should map to bracteole (PO_0009043). po_lexicon also lists bractlet as a synonym of bract (PO_0009055), which is ambiguous.
reason: The purplish parts are the involucel bractlets, i.e. bracteoles, not the involucral bracts.
The leaves are broadly ovate or reniform, recorded as shape alternatives with the 'broadly' qualifier.
The stem is usually not interlaced (tangled, in Cuscuta), with the negation and 'usually' kept.

fix: 'glaucous' should map to PATO_0104277 glaucous (a waxy bloom), not to a green colour value.
reason: Glaucous means covered with a bluish-grey waxy bloom, not green. PATO has a glaucous term.
The leaf base is semi-amplexicaul, i.e. partly clasping. Clasping (synonym amplexicaul) on the leaf is acceptable; the 'semi' degree is lost but nothing false is said.
The blade bases are narrowly auricled, so the leaf is auriculate.

fix: In 'sepal with spur, ..., whitish ...; spur 4–6 mm long, straight, greenish', the qualities after 'spur' belong to the spur, not the parent sepal.
reason: The spur is greenish; the lower sepal itself is whitish with yellowish to rusty markings.
The petiole is tuberculate.
The lateral leaflet blades are ovate to oblong-ovate or elliptic. Ovate or elliptic alternatives are right; the oblong-ovate step is omitted, but nothing is false.
The stem hairs are spreading. Spreading on trichome is right; the whole (the stem) isn't recorded, but the statement holds.

fix: In FNA 'proximal ...; mid ...; distal sessile, blades ...', the measurements belong to the leaf position named first and need the position slot.
reason: The 1–2.5 mm width is given for the blades of the distal leaves only. Proximal leaves are described separately and are larger.
The leaf blade margin is revolute.

fix: 'Outer/inner phyllaries N' counts need the outer/inner position. Without it the count reads as all phyllaries.
reason: 13-18 is the number of outer phyllaries only; Taraxacum also has inner phyllaries, so the total is higher.
